description:
Give work to your own AI teammates and get a call when it's finished. Connect your Benaiah account, choose a teammate, and share what you need drafted or analysed. Your results are saved in Benaiah so you can return to the same teammate and their work. You can also request a call to talk through the context you share.

Tasks use your Benaiah allowances or Credits; calls use Credits. Calls require an adult (18+) account holder who has enabled telephone access, a verified UK number and approval of the maximum cost. This version uses the context you provide; it does not automatically read other chats, browse the web or act in connected apps.
